evidence.note: New table-driven tests cover AllFixed, every atom (all_fixed, no_fixation_progress, max_iterations, budget, cmd), any/all/not composition, error-abort short-circuit, and 25 Validate/Parse rejection cases including MaxAtoms/MaxDepth boundaries; no TODO/FIXME, no eval, no unsafe execution.
Redaction contract asserted: cmd stdin payload hashes vars (sha256:), omits node outputs, and does not mutate the source snapshot.

TestF8Redaction checks a full marker leak/keep matrix (secret, home path, cmd streams, diff/porcelain detail), pairwise chain integrity for unredacted lines, manifest and snapshot projections, and include-vars behavior.

TestF8Refusals covers MaxBytes, symlink component, non-empty destination, every injected FS failure (lstat/readdir/mkdir/open/write/close), bad run ids, context cancellation, sidecar failures, and unknown-kind fail-closed.
Declaration-only file: interfaces, Deps wiring, status/record constants, error and warn codes. No logic, no unsafe execution, no markers; JSON-free type surface so no serialization risk.
Event and payload struct declarations with JSON tags only; omitempty usage is consistent with optional fields and there is no behavior to test directly.

Fingerprint for the epic context-risk finding is narrowed to a constant 'epic:context-risk' so it stays stable as RiskReasons vary; single-line, behavior-preserving for the finding body which still carries the reasons.

findings.note: Vacuous assertion: the open flags/perm check is an OR whose second branch (strings.Contains(o, "-rw-------")) is true for every recorded open, since memFS.OpenFile is only ever called with 0600. The O_WRONLY|O_CREATE|O_EXCL suffix comparison therefore never fails, and the itoa helper it depends on only encodes the low decimal digit of the flag (string(rune('0'+i%10))), so it could not distinguish flag values anyway. O_EXCL is separately covered against the real filesystem in TestOSFS, so this is a test-strength nit rather than a coverage gap.

evidence.note: func itoa(i int) string { return string(rune('0' + i%10)) } collapses flags to one digit
